verdict.rationale: Ramp documents OAuth 2.0 scopes in a resource:permission pattern (e.g. transactions:read, bills:write, cards:read_vault), explicitly advises configuring only needed scopes, and supports client-credentials grants. The CLI provides a dedicated `agent login` that exchanges client credentials for an agent identity, and agents.ramp.com describes one key per agent, tied to a human sponsor, with per-agent permissions. A live probe confirms the MCP server publishes granular read/write scopes, and sessions expire automatically. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of minting a narrowly scoped per-agent key end-to-end, and in-depth docs for the per-agent permission model beyond the agents.ramp.com marketing page.
